_doc: OPTIONAL AI guidance for volunteer-task pre-requisites / expectations, bound from the VolunteerGuidance configuration section (app settings / environment / Key Vault). Gated on ApiKey: leave it blank (the default) and the hub uses a built-in heuristic generator with no network call and no secret. Supply a real key only via the environment (VolunteerGuidance__ApiKey) or a Key Vault reference, never in a file.
